headline: 舞蹈經典迎一甲子
context: 美國編舞家伊冯·萊納（Yvonne Rainer）的作品《Trio A》，正在倫敦泰特現代美術館（Tate Modern）演出，紀念創作60週年。這部作品當年改變了整個舞蹈史的走向，如今免費開放觀賞，看的人裡有嬰兒、遊客，也有路過的人。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Tate Modern, London With this work, the choreographer changed the course of dance – and on its 60th anniversary, viewed by babies, tourists and passers-by, it’s as beguiling and hypnotic as ever At the back of the Turbine Hall, three people are dancing. If it weren’t for the vinyl dancefloor and the white line separating it from the audience, however, you might not immediately realise it. You could be forgiven for thinking that they were performing some idiosyncratic form of Tai chi or, if this were a different dancefloor, that they had taken rather too many drugs: one rolls around on the ground, another stretches his arms out wide, a third sinks to her haunches and touches her toes. All appear so enthralled by the actions of their own bodies as to be oblivious both to their partners onstage and the audience in front of them. This being Tate Modern on a Friday afternoon, that audience includes not only art school kids dressed in the same casual fashions as the performers onstage, but also babies screeching from pushchairs and mischievous schoolkids shouting heckles from the mezzanine. None of this seems to perturb the dancers. Having completed her routine, one walks away from the mat and disappears through a door at the back of the hall. The others follow in their own time, and the audience applauds. After a short interval, they are replaced on the stage by a new trio of performers, and the dance begins again. Yvonne Rainer: Trio A is at Tate Modern, London, on Saturday 11 July between 2pm and 8pm Continue reading...

thread_text:
舞蹈經典迎一甲子

美國編舞家伊冯·萊納（Yvonne Rainer）的作品《Trio A》，正在倫敦泰特現代美術館（Tate Modern）演出，紀念這部作品問世60週年。當年，它改變了整個舞蹈史的走向。

演出免費開放，看的人裡有嬰兒、遊客，也有路過的人。有評論形容，這場演出至今依然「迷人又催眠」，能免費看到這樣的經典，是一種難得的幸運。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 11 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
舞蹈經典迎一甲子

美國編舞家伊冯·萊納（Yvonne Rainer）的作品《Trio A》，在倫敦泰特現代美術館（Tate Modern）演出，紀念這部作品問世60週年。當年，它改變了整個舞蹈史的走向，如今依然被視為經典。

演出免費開放，觀眾裡有嬰兒、遊客，也有單純路過的人。有評論形容，這場演出至今依然迷人又催眠，能免費看到這樣一部經典作品，是一種難得的幸運。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 11 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 倫敦有一場很特別的免費演出。編舞家伊冯·萊納（Yvonne Rainer）的作品《Trio A》，在泰特現代美術館演出，紀念這部作品問世60週年。它當年改變了整個舞蹈史的走向。台下觀眾裡有嬰兒、有遊客，也有單純路過的人。有評論說，這場演出至今依然迷人又催眠。
